name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: DEBUG BUILD (v0.6.4.2): same test doCleanup() as 0.6.4.1 (service + getCerts() + return, no filter/cert9.db/delete -- PROVEN in 0.6.4.1 to break reading at send). Added in hookSendButton, right after the send-button interception and BEFORE doCleanup(), a block of console.log diagnostic lines that dump the signing-identity globals of the compose window: probes for the hypothetical 'emailSigningIdentity' global (NOT a real Thunderbird global -- comm-central MsgComposeCommands.js uses `var gCurrentIdentity;` at line 130 and reads the signing cert via identity.getUnicharAttribute('signing_cert_name') at line 1821) plus the real `gCurrentIdentity`/email/signingCertName, so we can confirm which variable to use for the upcoming search-only doCleanup(). No behavior change otherwise.
